business_problem: FizzDragon needed to coordinate a decentralized network of over 130 creators across 13 countries to produce a cinema-grade feature film. This required a highly scalable and stable IT infrastructure to support its "AIGC Global Creator System," a complex platform integrating over 20 mainstream video AI tools and nearly 100 proprietary AI agents. The core challenge was managing immense AI inference workloads and orchestrating a distributed, collaborative production pipeline that rivals traditional studios.

FizzDragon is a Singapore-based, pioneering technology and entertainment company that operates the world's first full-process Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) film production platform. Designed to democratize filmmaking, it allows creators to generate entire movies, series, and webcomics directly from scripts.

Scalable Global Collaboration : Successfully scaled a global creator network from 130 to over 600 studios, proving the platform's ability to handle explosive growth and distributed workflows. Validated Business Model : Enabled the world's first AIGC feature film to achieve a theatrical release and commercial success in Singapore and Malaysia, proving the viability of the decentralized production model.
